text: Snow-covered mountains appear under a pale sky as words fade in: "THE BLENDER FOUNDATION PRESENTS".
Words appear: "THE DURIAN OPEN MOVIE PROJECT" over snow-capped peaks, then fade as "A BLENDER INSTITUTE PRODUCTION" appears.
A lone figure walks across the snowy mountains, leaving footprints, heading toward stone ruins under a misty sky.
A young woman with short red hair trudges through snow, clutching a staff, her scarf pulled high against the cold.
A figure appears.
The young woman with short red hair stumbles and falls in the snow.
The young woman fights a bald man.
The woman falls into snow.
Bald man wipes face.
A young woman with short red hair kneels in snow, staff beside her, as boots approach.
Bald man with black moustache snarls, pinning red-haired woman in snow.
She grips her staff as the bald man holds her wrist.
The young woman lies in snow, eyes fluttering open, mouth slightly agape, wearing a brown coat.
A gloved hand grips a staff in snow.
A person walks across snowy mountains, carrying a long staff.
The person falls face down in the snow, motionless.
A fire pit glows at the centre.
An old man holds a staff. A young woman kneels.
A woman with red hair looks down, then darkness.
A vast town under hazy sky.
A young woman with short red hair walks through a sunlit, debris-strewn alley.
In a grey tank top, she grabs a dark sleeve, then holds up a red apple.
She turns, holding a spiky fruit.
The woman leaps over rubble.
She climbs a rooftop.
A small tan dragon with a bleeding wing sits on a tiled rooftop, mouth open, as blood pools beside it.
A woman with red hair stands.
The dragon lies on a stone roof.
She reaches toward it.
In the hideout, a young woman with short red hair smiles while a tan-brown creature roars with its mouth open.
A young woman with short red hair sits cross-legged, cradling a small tan creature in her lap, gently stroking its head as it rests against her.
A hand dips into a stone bowl.
Now the young woman kneels beside a glowing pink crystal in a dark, cluttered ruin.
She sleeps beside the small tan dragon, Scales, in the dim ruin.
The woman holds Scales' claw.
Chicken runs through sunlit alley.
The young woman with short red hair leaps over a cart.
She steps onto a crate.
Now she walks past wooden stalls and a seated man.
A young woman with short red hair stands in the town, her expression shifting as a figure approaches.
The small tan dragon, Scales, perches on a wooden beam, watching birds fly across the sky.
Then the young woman runs up stone steps.
She runs across a ruined stone fortress at sunset as red-winged creatures fly overhead.
Now she stands on a rocky ledge.
She runs.
Then she stands before a ruin at sunset.
The young woman with short red hair looks up as dragons fly past.
The dragon soars through pink clouds toward a ruined town where a young woman stands.
The dragon flies toward a hand.
On the plain of stumps, a young woman with short red hair gasps as a creature lifts her into the air.
A young woman with red hair lies prone as a huge dragon looms overhead, then leaps away over broken stone under a dusky sky.
A young woman with short red hair stands amid ruins, eyes wide, mouth open.
She stares forward, her expression shifting from surprise to a fierce, narrowed gaze.
In the desert, a young woman with short red hair clenches her fists.
Dusk. The plain of stumps. A young woman with short red hair watches a distant figure on a hill.
A lone figure walks across vast golden dunes under a bright sun.
A young woman lies on her back among tall green bamboo stalks.
Then she balances on a fallen bamboo stalk.
A young woman with short red hair fights a snarling beast in red rocks.
On a misty green hillside, a warrior with a metal leg and a spear stands.
A woman in a dark hooded coat holds a staff, her face strained against a misty, rocky backdrop.
She climbs a steep, snow-covered cliff face with her staff.
The figure climbs higher on the snow-covered cliff, the vast white mountainside stretching above.
A person with red hair crawls through snow.
A person walks uphill through snow, staff in hand.
A young woman with short red hair walks across the snowy mountains, carrying a long staff, leaving footprints.
On a moonlit slope, a young woman with short red hair stands and swings her staff as a figure leaps above her.
She looks down, then lifts her gaze.
An old man with a grey beard, a red stripe of face paint across his eyes and a beaded headband, in red-brown robes, holds his head down.
The emblem fades, revealing a tree with thick roots on dark rock.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, holds her staff under a full moon beside a gnarled tree.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, stands mouth under a full moon.
In the dark cave, Sintel holds a curved blade, facing glowing crystals.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, touches a dark scaled creature in dim light.
The vast cave floor glows with crystals.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, runs across a massive root bridge in a dark cave.
She leaps down with her staff.
The red-haired woman, Sintel, walks toward a pale dragon curled up asleep in the dark cave.
Sintel climbs a cave wall.
She touches glowing crystals on the wall, then turns, wielding her blade. A dark grey dragon lunges, and she dodges.
The huge dark grey dragon looms in the cave.
The red-haired woman clutches a staff and a tattered cloth.
She lunges at the dragon.
A creature with ram's horns and wings stands in darkness.
The red-haired woman lies motionless.
She grips her staff in the dark cave.
Sintel grips her staff tightly.
She stares wide-eyed.
The huge dark grey dragon rests in the cave.
The red-haired young woman lies on the cave floor, staring upward.
Sintel touches her cheek, eyes wide, as the cave darkens around her.
She stares at her gloved hand, then looks up, her face bruised and tense.
The red-haired young woman stands in the cave, facing the huge dragon’s head, her hands open before her.
She looks down, then lifts her gaze upward.
The huge dark grey dragon lies still, its eye dimming, as Sintel stands over it.
The red-haired young woman runs through the dark cave as rocks fall around her.
Darkness.
Dim rocky cave with gnarled tree roots on the ledge's right.
A lone figure sits atop a rocky slope beneath a giant tree.
The red-haired young woman, Sintel, sits on a cliff edge, head bowed, as small dark shapes fly past distant peaks.
She winces in pain.
Her eyes widen in shock as she stares forward.
Sintel stands on the rocky slope, gazing under a hazy sky.
Sintel walks away from the camera toward the misty mountains, white flowers nearby.
Her figure shrinks against the vast, hazy mountains as she continues walking.
The dragon lies on the rocky ground, its wing bleeding, as Sintel walks farther away.
Back in the snowy mountains, the dragon lies on the rocky ground. Sintel walks away.
